name: seriouseats.com
body: Every page has a title, and model-training crawlers are blocked by choice. But 7 AI answer or search crawlers are blocked.
lesson: Decide per bot in robots.txt: allow the answer engines you want to be cited by, and block only training crawlers.
summary: The site's bot protection refused the plain request; the page was analyzed in headless Chrome. Partial analysis: 19 of 19 linked pages answered with a bot check or a block, so the scores rest mostly on the start page. www.seriouseats.com scores 70 out of 100 (C). 5 checks fail now, 18 are at risk, and 30 pass. Fix first: 7 AI answer or search crawlers are blocked.

fix.title: 7 AI answer or search crawlers are blocked
fix.evidence: Claude-SearchBot (Claude search) by Disallow: /, Claude-User (Claude, when a person asks it to open a page) by Disallow: /, PerplexityBot (Perplexity answers) by Disallow: /, Perplexity-User (Perplexity, when a person asks it to open a page) by Disallow: /,…
fix.fix: Allow the answer bots in robots.txt. Training bots can stay blocked if that is the policy.

fix.title: Tracking starts before the visitor chooses
fix.evidence: OneTrust was showing. Before any choice, Chromium from an EU address (Belgium) saw Google Analytics (7 requests), Google Ads (31 requests), and cookies _ga, _gcl_au, _ga_48FDR9J6FP, _ga_DK3GDWHWJH.
fix.fix: Hold every tag until consent, or set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads. Block third-party embeds until the visitor agrees.

fix.title: Tracking continues after Reject
fix.evidence: After pressing "Reject All" and reloading, Google Ads (48 requests), Google Analytics (7 requests), Criteo (2 requests) still appeared.
fix.fix: Map every tag in the consent tool to a category and block it until that category is accepted.

fix.title: Elements must have their visible text as part of their accessible name
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 4 elements on /, for example a[aria-label="View Daniel Gritzer"] and a[aria-label="View Megan O. Steintrager"]. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Start the aria-label with the words that are visible on the control.

fix.title: 1 session cookie is readable by scripts
fix.evidence: Without HttpOnly: globalTI_SID. A script injected into the page could steal the session. Set on /.
fix.fix: Set Secure on every cookie, and HttpOnly plus SameSite=Lax on session cookies.

fix.title: Analytics may count some visits twice
fix.evidence: 1 page sends to more than one GA4 property. 1 page loads gtag.js more than once.
fix.fix: Keep one GA4 property per site and load gtag.js once, or manage it only inside Tag Manager.

works.title: Model-training crawlers are blocked by choice
Plain http redirects permanently to https
Every image has an alt attribute
The largest element paints in 1.0 s
Every page has a meta description
A sitemap answers with valid URLs
